description: Source mutations for the public fan speed-up time and early-layer speed ramp contracts.

mutants.description: Disable the buffered fan lead-time scheduling branch in the one FanMover implementation file; the 0.5 s public row must advance the ordinary PWM102 event.
Increase the non-raft ramp denominator by one. The 3-layer public row expects 3600 and 5400 mm/min on layer indices 1 and 2.
